# Laatent understanding
"Understanding and Action (Praxis and Teche)"

According to Human history, our understanding often proceeds action, and our action preceeds implementation. 

Is there a way to reduce this or reduce it's harmful effects?

According to our studies with Cyberoptics, the Human faculty of reasoning has a specific set of Affordances. We tend to struggle with time-based tasks, but are incredibly adept at spatial-navigation.
